rationale: I independently recomputed plan_ref sha256:bb2ea18f2a53885cb60b45d8a54c8d25e47a5b9e93c7c091a5948903b1bcf7a6 and confirmed the plan bytes match reviewed commit 97becd37ba2e99055f13c97ad6780eb06c8d0e34. E1–E6, the successor-authority bootstrap, Phase-0/Phase-1a contracts, release controls, and atomic re-weave sequencing are implementation-ready and consistent with the repository’s fail-closed, content-addressed trust model. I ratify SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM: deferring the concrete declarative grammar/evaluator is acceptable because it is a hard pre-implementation merge gate on the oracle-hardening slice; no normative oracle may ship before its adversarial conformance tests pass, while source review plus the deterministic battery remain compensating interim controls rather than semantic-soundness proof. I also ratify all recorded open-question dispositions, including Option-A AM-42/AM-43 re-authorization, reconcile-and-supersede authority repair, exceptionless auditing, the production-profile default flip, the non-blocking package-name fallback, and product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral. Deferred Phase-1b, broader-browser, and self-contained npm capabilities are honestly bounded and do not create plan defects. Council approval remains distinct from the required successor-authority pivot and the Eye’s implementation-authority confirmation.
